narrator.direction: Intimate documentary thriller; mid-low register; precise and restrained.

cassian.direction: Warm analytical baritone; clipped under pressure; dry humor; no accent caricature.

imani.direction: Low composed mezzo; exact consonants; surgical dry humor.

nico.direction: Agile charismatic tenor; broadcast polish; slows markedly when listening.

pike.direction: Firm low alto; measured command; rare cracks in control carry weight.

loam.direction: Androgynous synthetic clarity; narrow pitch; no fake empathy; microscopic agency over time.

seren.direction: Female or androgynous contralto; patient testimony; burdened, never mystical cliché.

shaal.direction: Alien masculine bass-baritone; immaculate calm; compelling, not monstrous.

nara.direction: Grounded alto or mezzo; tactile and ordinary; moral specificity without mysticism.

abena.direction: Mature warmth without sentimentality; deliberate comic timing; culturally authentic casting.
